title: A3-F1/F2: source-prose fields must be contiguous verbatim source (Iron Flask cells, interior table splices, bullet joins)
description: Second-audit blocker: recurrence of the o9bd.16 L1-F2 class repaired in .16.7.5 (19.6.4 AC: repaired classes must not recur), verified by Captain at 6812cc0b. (1) table:iron-flask rows carry '01-50' (invented leading zero, U+2013) under source-prose; SRD p.228 prints '1' + dash glyph + '50' (curated spec parseDocumentTables.ts:961-1000 hand-writes the cells). (2) Ten records keep source-prose after a printed table was spliced out of the interior: rule:ability-checks, rule:ability-scores-and-modifiers, rule:expenses-lifestyle-expenses, rule:half-dragon-template, rule:hit-points, rule:objects, rule:services, rule:skills, rule:speed, condition:exhaustion /description. (3) Lower-consequence sibling: 11 condition descriptions plus feat:grappler and feature:monk:martial-arts join printed bullets with the glyphs removed while declared verbatim. Full evidence and the contiguity query: Fable report on eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.3 (branch audit/eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.3-fable @ 5b153637). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
design: 2026-11-06 DESIGN (Captain), within the 2026-11-05 user adjustment (faithful source-prose; no undisclosed composition or substitution; legitimate extraction/layout differences accommodated; literal cross-extraction contiguity is NOT a universal rule). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md and docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. Extend the mechanism the o9bd.16 L1-F2 repair built (eshyra-o9bd.16.7.2 / .16.7.5, PR #701: stripEmbeddedTableProse.ts, fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts, the internal-splice report, internalSpliceAndOptionCitations.test.ts, composedDisplayProvenance.test.ts; read their thaw notes 2026-11-01-eshyra-o9bd-16-7-2-*.md and -16-7-5-*.md) rather than inventing a parallel one. (1) INTERIOR SPLICES: every producer that removes a printed table (or list) from the interior of a field emitted as source-prose must report it, so the compiler generates a scoped source-derived declaration with its reason (nothing hand-listed). Known members at 6812cc0b: rule:ability-checks, rule:ability-scores-and-modifiers, rule:expenses-lifestyle-expenses, rule:half-dragon-template, rule:hit-points, rule:objects, rule:services, rule:skills, rule:speed (rule /text) and condition:exhaustion /description; derive membership from the producers, then reconcile against this list. (2) BULLET JOINS: condition descriptions (blinded, charmed, frightened, grappled, invisible, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious), feat:grappler and feature:monk:martial-arts join printed bullets with the glyphs removed while declared verbatim with a wrong reason ('intro line'): either keep the printed bullet structure faithfully or declare the composed field source-derived with a correct reason; choose the smaller faithful change and apply it to the whole producer class. (3) SUBSTITUTION: table:iron-flask curated spec (parseDocumentTables.ts ~l.961-1000) hand-writes '01–50'; SRD p.228 prints '1' + dash glyph + '50'. Emit the printed value ('1–50', dash transcribed like other range cells) so no invented character remains; check every other reviewed-reconstruction spec for invented characters. (4) EVIDENCE: a generalized invariant for this class (a source-prose leaf may differ from its cited extraction only by whitespace/hyphenation/layout/glyph-encoding normalisation; interior removal or joined-with-glyph-removal requires a generated scoped declaration), with these records as the reproducer set; regenerate the pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd as the protocol says) and npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack must pass; add a thaw note under docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/ like the 16.7.x ones. Do NOT touch freeze-manifest.json hashes. Fable report with the full evidence and contiguity query: bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.3. Implementer: Claude Sonnet 5.5.
acceptance_criteria:
- No source-prose leaf contains undisclosed composition (interior splice, joined bullets with glyphs removed) or substitution (invented characters such as the Iron Flask leading zero); each such leaf is either restored to faithful text or covered by a generated scoped source-derived declaration with its reason; nothing hand-listed.
- Legitimate extraction/layout differences (whitespace, hyphenation, column flow, glyph encoding) are accommodated, not reported as defects; literal substring contiguity across extractions is not imposed as a universal rule.
- Generalized regression evidence for the composition/substitution class, with the Iron Flask cells, the ten interior-splice records and the bullet-join records as the reproducer set; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes after regeneration.
notes:
2026-11-05 USER ADJUSTMENT (supersedes conflicting text above): do NOT make literal substring contiguity across PDF extractions a universal requirement. Preserve the invariant that source-prose is faithful, with no undisclosed composition or substitution, while accommodating legitimate extraction/layout differences (whitespace, hyphenation, column flow, glyph encoding such as CID dashes).
